title: How We Used Codex to Ship Sora for Android in 28 Days
summary: OpenAI shipped Sora for Android in 28 days using Codex. AI-assisted planning, translation, and parallel coding workflows helped a nimble team deliver rapid, reliable development.
body: OpenAI shipped Sora for Android in 28 days using Codex. AI-assisted planning, translation, and parallel coding workflows helped a nimble team deliver rapid, reliable development.
summaryZh: OpenAI团队通过Codex辅助工具，在28天内完成了Sora安卓版的开发与发布。该项目利用AI进行需求规划、代码翻译及并行开发工作流，证明了AI辅助开发在缩短产品上市周期方面的实际效能。原始信息显示：OpenAI shipped Sora for Android in 28 days using Codex. AI-assisted planning, translation, and parallel coding workflows helped a nimble team deliver rapid, reliable development.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How We Used Codex to Ship Sora for Android in 28 Days”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了利用AI辅助编码工具在极短时间内完成复杂产品开发的工作流优化案例。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
